name: amionline
title: Am I Online
description: Check whether you are actually online and see which part of the connection is failing when you are not.
author: mert_tufekci

commands.name: status
commands.title: Check Connection
commands.subtitle: Am I Online
commands.description: A detailed, layer-by-layer connection check with a clear verdict.

preferences.name: customTargets
preferences.title: Custom Targets
preferences.description: Also check these hosts. Comma or newline separated. Use host:port (e.g. 192.168.1.222:8081) or a full URL.

preferences.name: showEgressIp
preferences.title: Privacy
preferences.label: Show your public IP address in results
preferences.description: Your public IP is read from the Cloudflare check and shown only when this is on. It is never stored or sent anywhere else.

preferences.name: identifyUpstream
preferences.title: DNS
preferences.label: Identify the upstream resolver behind a local DNS (one extra lookup)
preferences.description: Runs one extra DNS lookup (whoami.akamai.net) to reveal the public resolver your local DNS forwards to.
